# The Pragmatic Programmer for Gemini CLI

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/pragmatic-programmer/ in the guided-plugins repository.

Install from a checkout of the repository (Gemini installs one extension per repository from GitHub, so use the local path):

```bash
gemini extensions install ./dist/gemini/pragmatic-programmer
```

- 38 skills (including 6 mode skills), each also a slash command `/pragmatic-programmer:pragmatic-programmer-<name>`.
- 20 subagents, started with `@pragmatic-programmer-<name> <task>`.
